stories.title: Salvador Perez Passes George Brett — New Royals All-Time HR Leader

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Salvador Perez is now the greatest home run hitter in Kansas City Royals history.

His 318th HR as a Royal on July 25 passed George Brett's 317 — a record Brett built over 21 seasons.

Perez is 36 years old and still hitting bombs. Royals legend. #Royals #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
George Brett: 317 HR over 21 seasons as a Royal. One of the greatest ever.

Salvador Perez: 318 HR (and counting) — passing him in 14 seasons.

That's the new bar in Kansas City.

#Royals #MLB

research.facts:
MLB Trade Deadline — 6 Days Out (August 3)
**Confirmed Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- August 3 MLB trade deadline at 6 PM ET (NOT July 31 — all search results confirm August 3)
- Tarik Skubal (Tigers, 2× reigning AL Cy Young winner): Tigers will decide "by end of the week" per executives; Friday at latest; Dodgers primary suitor; Tigers are 25-15 since June 1 (4th-best MLB record in that stretch)
- CJ Abrams (Nationals, .293/.25 HR/79 RBI, 111 hits, 2× All-Star): Nationals "willing to listen" but move "not seen as particularly likely"; Yankees and Brewers interested; Nationals already dealt Early for Mead which intensified speculation
- Foster Griffin (Nationals LHP, 2.68 ERA, 1.03 WHIP, NL All-Star): Multiple teams view departure as "inevitable"; more likely to go than Abrams
- Mitch Miller (Padres, 0.86 ERA, 78K in 41.2 IP, club control through 2029): "Sleeper" name; not a rental
- Already done: Red Sox acquired Curtis Mead (INF) from Nationals for SP Connelly Early
- Also done: Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek
- Yankees: looking for leverage relievers; open to dealing Camilo Doval
**Sources:** foxsports.com/stories/mlb/2026-mlb-trade-deadline-rumors-news-trades, espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/49410877, dodgersnation.com, clutchpoints.com
